workflow: One frozen bundle, one local site run, one aggregate return

primary.features: joint support and raw physiologic ARF evidence
primary.assignment: closest frozen prototype; insufficient support retained as I

cox.code_status: unknown category retained; no complete-case requirement

prediction.matched_four_model_cohort: complete adapted APACHE and measured-component SOFA
prediction.bootstrap_scope: resample patients and their fixed out-of-fold predictions; conditional on frozen phenotypes and fitted CV models

clocks: 72h landmark, overall and by frozen phenotype
methods: Aalen-Johansen hospital death/hospice versus live non-hospice discharge
survival.pooling: exact relative-duration event and censor histograms; reconstruct pooled risk sets centrally

returns: all four Cox endpoints and diagnostics
SOFA and adapted APACHE components, units and completeness
exact hourly support and ARF states
initial support to phenotype Sankey counts
full versus leave-one-site-out phenotype assignment agreement
out-of-fold ROC and daily tdAUC aggregate histograms
event and censor histories with patient-cluster bootstrap counts
limitations: Adapted APACHE is neither standard APACHE II nor APACHE IV
Prediction validation is internal to each site, not a predictor trained on other sites
Cancer stage, histology and treatment unavailable in common CLIF tables

input_data.cohort_comparison: Return rebuilt eligible and landmark counts against available Stage1 aggregate references; counts do not prove identical membership.
